title: Fusion

content:
Drum synthesizer module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) made of 6x Mutable Instruments Plaits (from the @WyrdAl port), including 2x analog drum kicks, snares and hi-hats emulations, made to be sequenced by the Grids module (trigs+accents -> aux+out).

select a page faster using aux and keys from F2 to B2 :

aux : "All Plaits" page (hold to show the revision number and global CPU usage)

F2 : mix pages
F#2 : Plaits "Kick AUX"
G2 : Plaits "Snare AUX"
G#2 : Plaits "Hi-hat AUX"
A2 : Plaits "Kick OUT"
A#2 : Plaits "Snare OUT"
B2 : Plaits "Hi-hat OUT"

Grids trig 1 -> Plaits "Kick AUX"
Grids trig 2 -> Plaits "Snare AUX"
Grids trig 3 -> Plaits "Hi-hat AUX"
Grids accent 1 -> Plaits "Kick OUT"
Grids accent 2 -> Plaits "Snare OUT"
Grids accent 3 -> Plaits "Hi-hat OUT"

#1 copy fusion_1-5.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install fusion_1-5.zop"

(will be installed into /media/orac/usermodules/synth)

v1.5 : notes routing changed for compatibility with the original grds module and Grids 2.3

v1.4 : major UI bugfix

v1.3 : UI adjustments, 2 mix pages added (key F2), 

v1.2 : Kick#1 bugfix and adjustments

v1.1 : Grids removed (now available as Grids 2.0 with improvements), now with separate controls for the 6 Plaits + global controls and mod
